name: norvia-monorepo
description: Monorepo corporativo Norvia: Frontend Next.js, API Gateway Node.js e Automações Independentes

scripts.test:nfe: cd backend/automations/automacoes-financeiro && uv run -q --no-project --python 3.11 --with-requirements requirements.lock --with pytest --with httpx pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:estoque: cd backend/automations/contagem-estoque && uv run -q --no-project --python 3.11 --with-requirements requirements.lock --with pytest --with httpx pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:marketplace: cd backend/automations/automacoes-marketplace && uv run -q --no-project --python 3.11 --with-requirements requirements.lock --with pytest --with httpx pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:producao: cd backend/automations/automacoes-producao && uv run -q --no-project --python 3.11 --with-requirements requirements.lock --with pytest --with httpx pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:marketing: cd backend/automations/automacoes-marketing && uv run -q --no-project --python 3.11 --with-requirements requirements.lock --with pytest --with httpx pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test: npm run test:gateway && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:gateway && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:nfe && npm run test:producao && npm run test:marketplace && npm run test:estoque && npm run test:marketing
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend/gateway run build -- --noEmit && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lock:python: for m in automacoes-financeiro automacoes-marketplace automacoes-marketing automacoes-producao contagem-estoque; do (cd backend/automations/$m && uv pip compile requirements.txt --universal --python-version 3.11 --generate-hashes --no-header -q -o requirements.lock) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:frontend
scripts.audit:npm: npm --prefix backend/gateway audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.audit:python: for m in automacoes-financeiro automacoes-marketplace automacoes-marketing automacoes-producao contagem-estoque; do (cd backend/automations/$m && uvx --python 3.11 pip-audit==2.10.1 -r requirements.lock --progress-spinner off) || exit 1; done
scripts.audit: npm run audit:secrets && npm run audit:npm && npm run audit:python
